## 1) Chart type
- **Faceted choropleth maps** of the United States.

## 2) Layout techniques
- Uses **small multiples / faceting**: four separate U.S. maps arranged in a **2×2 grid**.
- No stacking.
- Each facet shows the same geography with a different artist title.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Artist / facet title (Rihanna, Drake, Taylor Swift, Luke Bryan) | Categorical/nominal | **Faceting** into separate maps; **text title/label** above each panel |
| U.S. geographic region / county-like area | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | **Map position/shape** of polygons |
| Popularity (less popular → more popular) | Quantitative / ordinal (shown as ordered intensity) | **Color hue/lightness** from light pink to dark purple; also shown in **legend** |
| State boundaries | Categorical/nominal (geographic reference) | **Boundary lines** over the map |
